images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a simplified 16:9 landscape level-selector thumbnail for the Inferno / burn-after-reading game level, based on the supplied furnace room reference. Preserve its softly faceted stylized 3D game art, warm red brick, charcoal iron, copper pipes, brass rivets and amber lighting. Compact readable composition at 640x360: central large angular mail processing chute with a hopper holding a few clearly recognizable cream envelopes, flanked by two round-topped heavy CLOSED iron furnace doors with bright orange glowing seams. A few chunky copper pipes connect machinery, one simple pressure gauge, two warm hanging industrial lamps. Low metal workbench set slightly ahead of camera with visible front and legs, empty middle, a small red valve at left and tongs on right. Simplify away tiny clutter and storage bins. Central chute and envelope hopper form strong thumbnail focal point. LIGHT state: bright warm amber room illumination, readable copper and brick surfaces, cozy fiery workshop palette, orange furnace glow. No people, weapon, logo, text, UI, border or montage. One full-bleed 16:9 image.

Keep EXACT 16:9 crop, camera, geometry, every object position and silhouette: both closed arched furnace doors, three cream envelopes in hopper, copper pipe layout, gauge, lamps, central chute, front bench, valve and tongs.
